title: An invoiced part sale's Bill To is locked with Go To Invoice
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new part sale for this test, part sale 1, for customer A, invoiced (not paid), billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open part sale 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Hover over the Bill To field.
  4. Click the Bill To field.
  5. Click "Go To Invoice" in the toast.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part sale 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 3:

  • The tooltip reads "Invoiced. Reverse the invoice to change who's billed."

Step 4:

  • An error toast shows "Invoiced. Reverse the invoice to change who's billed." with a "Go To Invoice" button.

Step 5:

  • Part sale 1's Finance tab opens and the invoice is still there.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12307 (Story 5, Locked Bill To: invoiced and deposits)

  • S5-R1: “When Invoiced, the Bill To field is read-only with M4 as its tooltip.”
  • S5-R2: “Clicking or tapping the Invoiced field shows M4 as an error toast with a "Go To Invoice" button.”
  • S5-R3: “"Go To Invoice" opens the work order's or part sale's Finance tab; it never reverses anything.”
